verses.text: Listen, my children, to your father's teaching. Pay attention and gain understanding.
I am giving you good teaching. Do not turn away from what I tell you.
When I was a boy in my father's house, still young and my mother's only child,
my father taught me. He said, "Hold on to my words with all your heart. Keep my commands, and you will live.
Get wisdom. Get understanding. Do not forget my words or turn away from them.
Do not leave wisdom, and she will protect you. Love her, and she will watch over you.
Wisdom is the most important thing. So get wisdom. Even if it costs everything you have, get understanding.
Value wisdom highly, and she will lift you up. Hold her close, and she will bring you honour.
She will put a beautiful crown on your head. She will give you a glorious crown."
Listen, my son, and accept what I say. Then you will live for many years.
I have taught you the way of wisdom. I have led you along straight paths.
When you walk, nothing will hold you back. When you run, you will not trip.
Hold on tightly to what you have been taught. Do not let it go. Guard it well, because it is your life.
Do not set foot on the path of the wicked. Do not walk in the way of evil people.
Stay away from it. Do not go on it. Turn away from it and keep going.
Evil people cannot sleep until they have done something wrong. They lose sleep until they make someone fall.
They eat the bread of evil and drink the wine of violence.
The path of good people is like the first light of dawn. It shines brighter and brighter until it is full daylight.
But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness. They do not know what makes them trip.
My son, pay attention to what I say. Listen closely to my words.
Do not let them out of your sight. Keep them deep in your heart.
They are life to those who find them and health to their whole body.
Above everything else, guard your heart, because everything you do flows from it.
Keep your mouth from twisted talk. Keep lying lips far away from you.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Keep your gaze fixed on what is in front of you.
Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be secure.
Do not turn to the right or to the left. Keep your feet away from evil.
